days.topic: VPS vs shared hosting: what's the real difference?
days.caption:
VPS vs shared hosting — what's actually different? 🤔

Shared hosting puts your site on a server with hundreds of strangers, splitting the same CPU and RAM. A VPS gives you dedicated, isolated resources that are yours alone — plus root access to configure things your way.

If you've ever asked "why is my site slow for no reason," this is usually why.
